summary:
The consumer installer has been elegantly refactored from a monolithic script into a modular architecture, splitting pure codecs, transport, local persistence, and planning into separate leaf modules with strict, enforced one-way dependencies, improving maintainability, testability, and clarity without changing functional behavior.

<!-- award -->
🏛️ ARCHITECTURAL VIRTUOSO 🏛️
"Your architecture is like the Parthenon of modern code: proportional, harmonious, and seems
to withstand the pressure of time and changing requirements. Vitruvius records your patterns
for future generations."
